issue.title: Use Snapshot.config[:ios_version] if os_version is not given.

repository.name: fastlane
repository.description: 🚀 The easiest way to automate building and releasing your iOS and Android apps

issue.body:
Use Snapshot.config[:ios_version] if os_version is not given, #5976.
The call from runner.rb:200 only uses device_name.

body: Hi @cwilhelm Thanks for the PR. Can you add testing to it so we can merge faster? We'll work with you there 👍 Thanks!
Perfect, thanks @cwilhelm. I saw that the parameter was missing, however I couldn't cause a crash locally. In what use-cases did this cause an issue? Should we do a release for this change?

Maybe an important point is, that I use enterprise profiles.

My call of snapshot is 

```
snapshot(
    app_identifier: app_identifier,
    reinstall_app: true,
    localize_simulator: true,
   skip_open_summary: true
)
```

which fastlane outputs as

```
+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
|                                   Summary for snapshot 1.14.0                                    |
+----------------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------+
| app_identifier             | com.ieffects.xxx.demo.dev                                       |
| reinstall_app              | true                                                                |
| localize_simulator         | true                                                                |
| skip_open_summary          | true                                                                |
| devices                    | ["iPhone 6s", "iPhone 6s Plus", "iPhone 5s"]                        |
| languages                  | ["en-US", "de-DE"]                                                  |
| scheme                     | xxxDemo-dev                                                     |
| workspace                  | ./xxxDemo.xcworkspace                                           |
| output_directory           | /Users/cwilhelm/Documents/workspace/ifxshop/shops/iphone/xxx... |
| launch_arguments           | [""]                                                                |
| clear_previous_screenshots | false                                                               |
| erase_simulator            | false                                                               |
| buildlog_path              | ~/Library/Logs/snapshot                                             |
| clean                      | false                                                               |
| number_of_retries          | 1                                                                   |
| stop_after_first_error     | false                                                               |
+----------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------+
```

and the before mentioned backtrace. Do you need more information?
I tried running it with the exact same parameters and it's working just as expected for me. Could you upload a demo project or get it to fail on the snapshot sample project?
